description: MODEL FAMILY -> COMPATIBILITY SHIM. A shim is what a model family needs to speak a harness's wire protocol (here: Claude Code's Anthropic-compatible API through OpenRouter). It is independent of which capability class a model serves: the same family gets the same shim whether it is the code-low or the code-high model. Matched by glob against the canonical model id, first match wins; a model with no matching family gets no shim. Only families with a live-tested shim belong here — do not add speculative entries. Each shim is an OpenRouter preset whose source is routing/shims/<slug>/ (system_prompt.md, config.json), pushed, pulled, diffed and checked with tools/fabric/shim.py; routing.py check refuses an entry with no source.

shims.note: Z.ai GLM through OpenRouter needs the glm2claude-shim preset for Claude Code tool calling. The composite the runtime derives is `<model>@preset/glm2claude-shim`. The preset is system-prompt-only (OpenRouter `config: {}`: no provider routing, no parameter overrides); OpenRouter PREPENDS its text as the first system block, ahead of Claude Code's own billing-header block and main prompt, and injects it once (ori does not add it again). Verified live 2026-09-13 on every family member the profiles use — z-ai/glm-5.3, z-ai/glm-5.2, z-ai/glm-5.3-flash — generation ids and the /generation read-backs are in docs/live-checks/2026-09-13-openrouter-routing.md. Because it is prepended, the text works as a priming delta that defers to the live harness; whether an instruction placed AFTER Claude Code's prompt would carry more weight has not been tested, and the preset offers no way to place one there. ori warns that the composite is 'not in the OpenRouter catalog' and passes it through: presets are per-account and never in the public model list, so that warning is expected.

DeepSeek V4 through OpenRouter needs the deepseek2claude-shim preset for Claude Code: a prepended, system-prompt-only compatibility delta (turn discipline, harness markup is input never output, the live tool contract) plus provider routing. Live-checked 2026-09-14, read-backs in docs/live-checks/2026-09-14-deepseek.md. v4-pro-0813 passed a 6-step check at 33k context: every tool call correct, no invented turns, cache accounted per turn, the answer written unprompted; its one defect is an occasional first-turn emission of its native <|DSML|> tool markup in reasoning, which the harness nudges past. v4-flash-0731 failed the same check three times, with two different shim texts, always at the second or third long tool result (~25k context): it invents a user turn, imitates the harness's <system-reminder>/<total_tokens> tags, or loops on its own hallucination — a model property, not a routing one; no capability class may resolve to it. Provider: the preset pins `only: [ionstream]` with fallbacks off. DeepSeek's first-party endpoint is excluded by this account's OpenRouter privacy setting (it trains on paid prompts); without the pin, price sorting silently fell to Ionstream anyway, and Ionstream served every passing run. Cache-read on Ionstream is ~$0.03/M, a tenth of GLM 5.3's, which is what dominates a Claude Code session. Admission to a class (code-high, review) is architect-cto's decision under routing/policies/review-grade.json; this entry only makes the wire path correct.
